subject: Conditional PO waiver for PaperTrail trial
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ada Romero <ada.romero@papertrail.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Conditional PO waiver for PaperTrail trial

Hi Ada —

Great to meet you at last week's API deep-dive. We're excited to run the 30-day pilot you described. Quick procurement question so we can fast-track onboarding: does PaperTrail require a purchase order (PO) before we can be invoiced for a short-term pilot under $5k?

We can always route through our standard PO flow, but for small pilots Sales/Finance have asked if Procurement can grant a temporary invoice-only (no-PO) path for the first month to avoid delays. If PaperTrail is comfortable issuing an invoice without a formal PO for the pilot, we can:

- Accept a single invoice up to $3,000 for the month-long trial
- Provide a signed SOW/trial scope (attached)
- Require W-9 (if US entity) or equivalent tax form

Can you confirm PaperTrail's stance and attach any paperwork (W-9, invoice timing, or draft PO) so our procurement team can evaluate? I cc'd Kimberly from Procurement and Marissa (AE) so we can get a decision in one thread.

Thanks —

Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415 555 0182

Attachments: trial-scope-sow.pdf
From: Ada Romero <ada.romero@papertrail.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Lars Holm <lars.holm@papertrail.io>
Date: 2027-09-02T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Conditional PO waiver for PaperTrail trial

Hi Soojin —

Thanks — great to meet you too. For pilots under $5k our standard practice is flexible: we prefer a PO for production subscriptions, but for short evaluation periods we can accept invoice-only if the scope and payment terms are clear. I've attached our W-9 and a draft invoice template.

A couple of notes from Finance:
- We can issue a PO quickly if Redwood needs it before the first invoice, but typically it takes 3–5 business days.
- If Redwood accepts, we can send an invoice immediately (Net 30) and follow up with a PO for record-keeping.

Attaching: papertrail_w9.pdf, sample-invoice-template.pdf

Let me know which path works for you and Kimberly.

Best,
Ada Romero
Head of Partnerships, PaperTrail Inc.
ada.romero@papertrail.io

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ada Romero <ada.romero@papertrail.io>
Date: 2027-09-02T11:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Conditional PO waiver for PaperTrail trial

Hi team —

Thanks for the details, Ada. Procurement is open to a short-term invoice-only path for trials provided we collect a small evidence package and impose a dollar cap and a single-invoice constraint. Proposed approval conditions:

1) Trial cap: single invoice not to exceed $3,000
2) Evidence: signed SOW (trial-scope-sow.pdf) + vendor W-9 (or non-US tax form)
3) Term: one month maximum; any further engagement requires a PO or an approved Dedicated contract
4) Payment terms: Net 30; Redwood Finance will not hold the vendor until a PO arrives for the first invoice
5) Controls: vendor will be added to the temporary allowlist and procurement will close the loop by filing the PO retrospectively when it is issued on PaperTrail's side

I've attached our short procurement questionnaire (procurement-questionnaire.xlsx) — please complete the highlighted fields that relate to tax ID, billing address, and primary billing contact. That helps us reconcile invoices quickly.

If PaperTrail can agree to the conditions above, and the questionnaire is returned by EOD, I can authorize the temporary waiver. Marissa — happy for you to confirm commercials so we can proceed.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: procurement-questionnaire.xlsx
From: Lars Holm <lars.holm@papertrail.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ada Romero <ada.romero@papertrail.io>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Conditional PO waiver for PaperTrail trial

Hi Kimberly / Soojin / Marissa —

Thanks for outlining the conditions. PaperTrail Finance can accept the temporary arrangement with the following confirmations:

- We will return the completed procurement questionnaire by EOD (see attached draft answers).
- We will issue a PO for administrative purposes, but it may arrive after the first invoice. Please accept the first invoice without holding payment if it meets the $3k cap and matches the signed SOW.
- Billing contact: billing@papertrail.io; payment remittance address included in the W-9.

I'll attach a draft PO (papertrail-draft-po.pdf) for your records. If Redwood is comfortable accepting the invoice-first + retrospective PO approach, we are ready to kick off the trial tomorrow.

Regards,
Lars Holm
Head of Finance, PaperTrail Inc.
lars.holm@papertrail.io

Attachments: papertrail-draft-po.pdf
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Ada Romero <ada.romero@papertrail.io>, Lars Holm <lars.holm@papertrail.io>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Conditional PO waiver for PaperTrail trial — Approved

Hi Ada / Lars —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Procurement has authorized a temporary invoice-only path under the conditions Kimberly listed. Confirming next steps:

- PaperTrail will: provide completed procurement-questionnaire.xlsx, signed SOW (trial-scope-sow.pdf), and W-9 (papertrail_w9.pdf).
- Redwood will: accept the first invoice up to $3,000 without waiting for the administrative PO; Finance will post the vendor and (if necessary) file the PO retrospectively when PaperTrail's PO arrives.
- Payment terms: Net 30 per your invoice.

Marissa — please confirm the trial start date with the customer and share the invoice routing email (billing@papertrail.io) so we can close the loop on our side.

Thanks everyone — excited to get the pilot live.

Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Sign-off attachments collected: trial-scope-sow.pdf, papertrail_w9.pdf, procurement-questionnaire.xlsx, papertrail-draft-po.pdf
